research_objective.baseline: Reconstruct the final published Sun Stage 2 without an LLM.
research_objective.hybrid: Run the same Sun Stage 2 front end and call an LLM only under pre-registered fallback triggers.
research_objective.replacement: Replace the whole Sun Stage 2 with a direct LLM while preserving the same input IDs, output contract, evaluator, and Stage 3.
research_objective.primary_comparison: baseline vs hybrid vs replacement on identical frozen data and Gold
research_objective.downstream_question: Whether Stage 2 changes improve the unchanged Stage 3 matching and violation-detection results.

human_review_gate.notes: human_review_input_ready is true once the input gate is satisfied. The four orthogonal gates are: human_review_input_ready (user can start review at 0/150), human_review_freeze_ready (150/150 adjudicated, annotation frozen), formal_gold_publication_ready (route + data + stage3 + freeze policy all re-locked, ready to declare formal Gold), final_experiment_ready (everything including Stage 3 is locked). The route v2 being reopened does NOT block the input gate; it DOES block formal_gold_publication_ready. Agents must not infer or import any human review decision; the user remains the sole owner of approved/reviewed/adjudicated state changes.

formal_gold_publication_gate.status_changed_at_utc_event_23: 2026-07-13 Event 23 governance: this status field is now matched against the exact allowed_publication_statuses whitelist; the previous fail-open 'not blocked and not unknown' heuristic has been removed
required_preconditions: freeze_policy in experiment_contract has been re-evaluated and explicitly re-locked (no 'reopened_pending_*' status remains anywhere on the formal Gold publication path)
status field above is an exact match against allowed_publication_statuses (whitelist, not blacklist)
formal_gold_publication_gate.stage3_in_publication_preconditions: Stage 3 is currently REQUIRED as a precondition (the existing 'required_preconditions' array includes stage3.status == locked). Event 23 did not relax this; if a future contract revision explicitly demotes Stage 3, that change must be made in this contract and recorded in the audit log, not inferred silently. No automated Stage 3 unlock is permitted by Event 23.
formal_gold_publication_gate.conservative_policy: If any of the above fields is missing or non-locked, OR the status is not in the allowed_publication_statuses whitelist, formal_gold_publication_ready MUST be false. Do not infer; do not relax; do not auto-clear blockers. The previous 'not startswith blocked and != unknown' heuristic has been removed; the whitelist is exact and additive.
formal_gold_publication_gate.notes: human_review_freeze_ready (150/150 adjudicated) is a NECESSARY but NOT SUFFICIENT condition for formal_gold_publication_ready. The route v2 being reopened, official modality data not yet ingested, Stage 3 subset/violation Gold not yet locked, the freeze_policy still being in 'do not write formal input or Gold until ...' mode, or the publication status not exactly matching the whitelist each individually keep formal_gold_publication_ready false.
